assertions.name: knot_operator_recurrence_via_gram_verified
assertions.source: Exact sympy: sigma^2 obeys 2x2 Cayley-Hamilton -> two-term closure recurrence; the Markov Gram matrix is symmetric and makes sigma^2 self-adjoint (G*sigma^2 symmetric). Formalized generically in KnotOperatorRecurrence.lean (charpoly_two, pow_two_step, trace_two_step, twist_gram_selfAdjoint).

description: Twist-knot demonstration that knot operators give recurrences via the Gram form (companion to QOU/BraidKnot/KnotOperatorRecurrence.lean). On TL_2={1,e} the twist operator sigma^2 satisfies 2x2 Cayley-Hamilton (tr=(A^8+1)/A^6, det=A^-4); the Markov-trace closure sequence obeys a_(n+1)=tr*a_n-det*a_(n-1); the Markov-pairing Gram matrix G=[[delta,1],[1,delta]] (delta=-A^2-A^-2) is symmetric with cyclotomic det, and sigma^2 is G-self-adjoint, so G^-1 builds the Jones-Wenzl projector basis diagonalising it (eigen-channels A^2, A^-6). Twist knots 4_1,5_2,6_1,7_2 are the closures at n=1..4. This is the geometric/even-channel q-holonomic (quantum A-polynomial/AJ) structure; the bar-odd Q_beta D-ladder's proven non-q-holonomicity (KC22) is exactly its escape from this machinery. Exact sympy over Q(A); no fit.
